content.description: Graph showing the relationship between water temperature sensor resistance and temperature. The Y-axis shows resistance in kΩ on a logarithmic scale from 0.1 to 40, and the X-axis shows temperature in both Celsius (from -20 to 120°C) and Fahrenheit (from -4 to 248°F). Multiple diagonal lines show the resistance curve decreasing as temperature increases.

Illustration showing how to inspect the water temperature sensor using an ohmmeter. The diagram shows a hand holding an ohmmeter connected to a water temperature sensor, with the sensor partially submerged in what appears to be a testing container.

content.text: MEASURE RESISTANCE OF WATER TEMP. SENSOR

items: (b) Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between both terminals.
